avis.titre: simple and effective, gets the job done
avis.texte: Firstly, I love how affordable the brand is in general. I've realized that skincare products should never be ridiculously expensive (which is a large majority of products nowadays) when they all use essentially the same ingredients… Good Molecules is super transparent about what goes into their products and seems to only put in the important, effective stuff. This cleanser is great if you just want something super simple. No fragrance, gel consistency that lathers decently, and not drying. My previous go-to was the LRP toleriane foaming cleanser and this GM one was an awesome swap. LRP one was a bit drying but I preferred that over the creamy washes that leave me with a filmy feeling; this GM cleanser leaves my face feeling clean without the drying or the film, so I don't have to settle for one. 200 mL option is also *so* appreciated, especially considering how so many other brands only do like 100 or even 50 mL for $20+. If you don't need anything particularly fancy or targeted, this cleanser would probably be a top contender.

i recently had to switch to some more affordable products… i used to only use this wash in the shower, while i used my more prestige products to take off my makeup. i went back to this a few months ago and i forgot how good it is. its gentle, removes makeup and leaves my skin feeling clean ! i've noticed that it kinda struggles some times removing all of my makeup, i use a toner or and oil based balm after washing to make sure my skin is actually clean. which, i don't mind doing, especially for the price. plus, i always use a toner after washing my face.

Ive been using this cleanser for a few months now and honestly love how it makes my skin feel and look. I like to look closely at my face/pores before i use it and it could be in my head but i swear they look better after just washing my face
This cleanser has been very nice for my combination skin. I use it as my morning cleanser and it works well for my oily skin.

All I can say is where have you been all my life!

avis.titre: A Gentle, Hydrating Cleanser That Delivers
avis.texte: The Good Molecules Hydrating Facial Cleansing Gel is a gentle, affordable cleanser that removes oil, sunscreen, and light makeup without stripping the skin. With soothing ingredients like rosewater and pineapple extract, it helps calm and lightly brighten the skin over time. Fragrance-free and suitable for most skin types, it's a great everyday option that preps your face perfectly for the rest of your routine.
